dedupe_keys.name: dicra climate resilient agriculture data platform

description: DiCRA, Data in Climate Resilient Agriculture, is a geospatial data platform led by the Government of Telangana and UNDP with research partners. Its README describes open access to collaboratively curated climate and agricultural layers, analytical maps and APIs for policy use. Users select a location and theme; outputs are mapped data and indicators for climate-resilient food-system studies. Geographic coverage follows the areas and datasets contributed, with Telangana as a named partner. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the code; individual source datasets may carry separate terms. A limitation is that crowdsourced or collated layers can differ in age, resolution and validation, so they should not be assumed complete for every district. DiCRA can prepare exposure, land and water context for irrigation or agricultural supply-chain simulations. The related QGIS catalogue platform processes GIS layers but is not this curated data service. No spatial layer or platform installer was downloaded.
